sources.title: OpenClaw GitHub main repository

sources.title: Architecture Overview (tenten MasterClass)
sources.keyClaim: Four-layer architecture: Gateway (port 18789), Reasoning, Memory, Skills. Gateway is largest attack surface.

sources.title: OpenClaw Architecture and Insights (navant)
sources.keyClaim: Gateway = long-running WebSocket server; hub-and-spoke; typed protocol; device identity handshake.

sources.title: Plugin internals (docs.openclaw.ai)
sources.keyClaim: Capability model: registerProvider, registerTool, registerEmbeddingProvider, registerSpeechProvider, etc.

sources.title: Plugin architecture internals (docs.openclaw.ai)
sources.keyClaim: Load pipeline: discover -> manifest -> safety gates (path-escape/world-writable/ownership) -> register(api) -> registry. Manifest = control-plane source of truth.

sources.title: DeepWiki Plugin Architecture
sources.keyClaim: PluginRegistry manages plugins by shape (plain-capability, hybrid, hook-only, non-capability); slot-kinds memory/context-engine at-most-one.

sources.title: OpenClaw taxonomy.yaml
sources.keyClaim: 10,637-line / 635 KB capability catalog at repo root. Prime harvest target for devops-generators seed corpus.

sources.title: Capability ownership model (openclaw.cc)
sources.keyClaim: Plugin = ownership boundary for company/feature. Vendor multi-capability (openai, google, qwen). Consume shared capability not re-implement vendor behavior.

sources.title: crabfleet repository
sources.keyClaim: Mission control for agent runs. Maps to vivim TelemetryAggregator.

sources.title: clawgrit-reports repository
sources.keyClaim: Performance Reports for OpenClaw. Perf report schema for TelemetryAggregator.

sources.title: nora (solomon2773)
sources.keyClaim: Self-hosted control plane for OpenClaw/Hermes fleets. REST+CLI+MCP server. OTel gen_ai.* export. NemoClaw sandbox hardening.

sources.title: hearth (warrence)
sources.keyClaim: Self-hosted household AI chat on OpenClaw. Multi-user, long-term memory, PWA, NestJS. Multi-tenant memory model.

sources.title: openclaw-qwen35 (paulwlisto)
sources.keyClaim: Local Qwen model patches: tool-calling fix, JSON repair for nested args, tool-loop circuit breaker. Relevant to local providers.

sources.title: OpenClaw Architecture (ppaolo substack)
sources.keyClaim: OpenClaw = OS for AI agents; LLM provides intelligence, OpenClaw provides execution environment. Plugin extensibility.
